name: roofs_industrial_g
prompt:
Image 1 is the layout to paint into: 2 building outlines seen from above on flat magenta, in a 2×1 grid. Paint only its transparent area, which holds the left outline (cell 1); everything else stays as it is. Image 2 is finished art from the same game, to match in style only.

The fault of the last attempt at this cell: the roof was drawn about 17% too wide (842 px for a 718 px wide outline), running past the outline's right edge, and its ridge vent was missing. The roof now fills the outline's light-grey rectangle exactly, edge to edge: its left and right edges on the outline's sides, its top on the top edge, its bottom on the thick bottom edge. No magenta inside the outline.

Look straight down (orthographic): no perspective, no walls seen from the side, no ground. Style: clean, flat-shaded cartoon game art, bold dark outlines, muted natural colours, soft light from the top-left. No text. Details at true size; this hall stands beside cars 4 m long: roof sheet ribs about 0.2 m apart, a roof vent about 1 m, a ridge vent a narrow strip about 0.6 m wide along the ridge.

1. 33.8 × 10.5 m (3.2× wider than deep, a thin strip) — warehouse or workshop hall, shallow pitched roof of dark bitumen with a ridge vent along its length
